parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you authenticate using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request, which is unique to the repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. Find the organization ID in the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, if the URL is `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx`, the organization ID is `5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
